feeds_service


October 18, 2026


Last week we were proud to support the University of Saskatchewan College of Engineering's Hard Hat Ceremony, welcoming second-year engineering students into their chosen disciplines. More than 1,000 students, family members, alumni, faculty and industry leaders gathered to celebrate this important milestone - which sees the students presented with hard hats by alumni, faculty and industry representatives. A special thanks to Cameco's Nathaniel Kozicki and Mark Sherwood for helping welcome the next generation of engineers. Here's to building bright futures, one hard hat at a time! 👷‍♂️👷‍♀️
